gms_gumbel_experiment.memory_note: gumbel_softmax vmaps an n-length softmax over n keys, i.e. n x n float64 intermediates (8 MB at n=1000). Peak scope memory 440 MB (mostly JAX/XLA/ott runtime); no memory pressure at n=1000. At the upstream n=10000 one n x n float64 array is 800 MB (not run here).

data_and_seed_provenance.rnd_keys: repo/diffres/experiments/rnd_keys.npy (uint32 (10000,2), sha256 6e60685445936e0380220f34fc3fd15b5b7720070dc8c8f7f1148575de4ff5df), copied unchanged into run_native/ and run_capture/
data_and_seed_provenance.resampling_key_derivation: row 0 of rnd_keys.npy, then the script's chain of jax.random.split(key)[0] calls (5 splits) before the resampling call
data_and_seed_provenance.data_generation: script's own code: 5-component GM in d=8 (ms ~ U(-5,5), covs = a a^T + I), prior samples via diffres.tools.sampling_gm, exact posterior via diffres.tools.gm_lin_posterior with y = obs_op @ mixture mean, obs_op = ones(1,8), obs_cov = I_1
data_and_seed_provenance.weights: log_ws = sum N(y; obs_op x, 1) log-likelihood, normalised by logsumexp; ESS = 129.54 of 1000, max weight 0.01084

inputs.contents: float64 unless noted: key_mc (uint32 2), resampling_key (uint32 2), tau (0.1), mc_id (int64 0), vs (5), ms (5,8), covs (5,8,8), obs_op (1,8), obs_cov (1,1), y (1), post_vs (5), post_ms (5,8), post_covs (5,8,8), prior_samples (1000,8) [resampler samples], log_ws (1000) [resampler log weights], ws (1000), post_samples (1000,8), approx_post_log_ws (1000), approx_post_samples (1000,8), err (), residual (8), approx_m (8), true_m (8)
inputs.resampler_call: jax.jit(lambda k, lw, x: gumbel_softmax(k, lw, x, 0.1))(resampling_key, log_ws, prior_samples) with jax_enable_x64=True

reference_results.interpretation: Single MC run at n=1000; not comparable as a Table-1 statistic (paper averages 100 runs at n=10000). Reference numbers are for exact-replay verification of the tool, not a reproduction of the paper's table.

replay_comparisons.native_vs_capture (separate processes, s: post_samples, approx_post_log_ws, approx_post_samples, err, residual: bitwise equal; result .npz files byte-identical
replay_comparisons.replay_jit_vs_capture (fresh process, gu: approx_post_log_ws, approx_post_samples, err, residual: bitwise equal (max abs diff 0.0)
replay_comparisons.replay_eager_vs_capture (gumbel_softmax: approx_post_log_ws bitwise equal; approx_post_samples not bitwise, max abs diff 4.44e-15, max rel diff 7.49e-13 (XLA fusion/reassociation of the softmax @ samples product); within the ~1e-12 float64 tolerance
replay_comparisons.recommended_tool_test_tolerance: exact for log weights; for particles atol 1e-12 if the tool jits like the script, otherwise atol ~1e-13 / rtol 1e-11 (eager vs jit differs at 4e-15)
replay_comparisons.metric_replay_note: err recomputed with the script's swd definition (ott sliced_wasserstein PNormP(p=1), n_proj=1000, default rng) gives the identical value 0.227317260122535

gms_gumbel_experiment.figures: not applicable: the script produces no plots
limitations: Only MC id 0 at n=1000 (vs. 100 runs at n=10000 upstream); paper Table 1 statistics are not reproduced.
The capture driver obtains inputs from the script's module globals after runpy execution; they are exactly the arrays the script passed to gumbel_softmax.
The replay driver duplicates the script's 2-line metric wrappers (swd, residual einsum) to recompute metrics; the resampler itself is called from diffres.resampling.
run_gms.sh launches --tau=0. (not 0.1); tau=0 would divide by zero in gumbel_softmax. Not run.
